sources.name: IQOQI Vienna
sources.scope: Every numbered entry in the open and solved tables. Status is the catalogue's own classification.

sources.name: QIQCOP Zoo
sources.scope: Every current database/problems_json record in the maintainer repository, including solved questions. Merged aliases have no separate row.

sources.name: Clay Millennium Prize Problems
sources.scope: All seven historical prize problems. The source distinguishes active, unsolved, and solved. The collection includes pure mathematics.

sources.name: Wolfram Rule 30 Prizes
sources.scope: All three sponsor statements. This cellular-automaton collection is archived in the lab's physics intake.

sources.name: OpenProblems.net
sources.scope: Distinct labelled outbound URLs in the home-page table, plus unlinked physics-section lines with question marks or explicit problem labels. Historical links may have expired. Other narrative and nested websites have no question-level denominator.

sources.name: Zhang et al. spin sequences
sources.scope: Each published sequence in Table 2 of arXiv:2504.00987v1. These are finite benchmark inputs.

sources.name: Recorded arXiv intake
sources.scope: Every distinct lead saved by the lab's weekly arXiv query. The query samples up to six recent abstracts from three categories and matches open-question language.
